histoire.title: Our Story
histoire.text1: Born from a passion for authentic Togolese cuisine, Eza Zozo is more than just a restaurant. It's an invitation to discover the flavors of our terroir, passed down from generation to generation.
histoire.text2: Every dish we serve is prepared with love and respect for tradition. Our grilled tilapia, marinated with local spices, embodies the very essence of Lomé's cuisine.
histoire.text3: Here, every meal is a warm experience. Our welcoming space is designed to make you feel at home, surrounded by good cheer and enticing aromas.
histoire.text4: Come share a convivial moment with us. Whether for a quick lunch or a family dinner, we'll be delighted to welcome you and share our passion with you.

step1.title: The Tilapia
step1.text: Freshly caught, our tilapia is carefully selected for its tender flesh and delicate taste. Each fish is prepared the same day to ensure optimal freshness.

step2.title: The Ember
step2.text: Slowly grilled over hot coals, the tilapia acquires a crispy texture on the outside while remaining juicy inside. Our secret: perfectly mastered cooking time.

step3.title: The Sides
step3.text: To complete the experience, we offer a selection of traditional sides: crispy alloco, creamy rice sauce, or fresh attieké. Each choice will elevate your tilapia.
